notes: Source is Raritan's own auto-generated "Technical Specifications / Engineering Submittals" PDF (rev20250625) from their product-selector CDN — authoritative and complete for physical I/O, including a control-panel port diagram and electrical one-line diagram. AC input is a captive cord ending in an IEC 60309 2P+E 6h 16A pin-and-sleeve plug (IP44); no exact match exists in the allowed connector list, so nema-5-15 was used as the closest "captive-cord/plug" placeholder (same convention already used in this catalog for other PDUs with non-listed plug types, e.g. Tripp Lite PDUMH30HVAT). All 8 outlets are IEC 60320 C13, 10A, individually metered/switched. Sensor/Expansion/Feature/Console-Modem ports are physically RJ45 8P8C jacks but carry proprietary Raritan bus or RS-232 signaling rather than graded Ethernet, so no bandwidth grade was set on them; only the two ETH ports (Gigabit primary, Fast-Ethernet redundant secondary) got grades, per the spec's "Networking" line. Optional 802.11a/b/g/n Wi-Fi is via a USB dongle, not a fixed physical port, and is omitted from the port list. Unit is 1U (17.3" x 7.2" x 1.7"), mounts via RACK-KIT-DPX-1U.

ports.name: AC Input
ports.note: Captive ~3m (9.84 ft) rear-feed power cord terminating in an IEC 60309 2P+E 6h, 16A, 230V (200-240V rated) pin-and-sleeve 'Commando'-style plug, IP44. IEC 60309 is not in the connector list; nema-5-15 used only as the closest 'captive-cord/plug' placeholder category — the actual plug is round IEC 60309, not NEMA 5-15.

ports.name: Outlet 1
ports.note: IEC 60320 C13, 10A; individually metered and remote-switchable; SecureLok-compatible.

ports.name: ETH2 (10/100)
ports.note: Secondary, redundant Fast Ethernet management port.

ports.name: Sensor
ports.note: RJ45 port for daisy-chaining Raritan environmental sensors (temperature, humidity, air flow, differential pressure, water leak, contact closure); proprietary sensor bus, not graded Ethernet, so no bandwidth grade set.

ports.name: Expansion
ports.note: RJ45 expansion port for Raritan accessory modules; proprietary bus, not graded Ethernet, so no bandwidth grade set.

ports.name: Feature
ports.note: RJ45 feature port for Raritan accessories (e.g. asset-management strips); proprietary bus, not graded Ethernet, so no bandwidth grade set.

ports.name: Console / Modem
ports.note: RJ45 jack carrying RS-232 for local serial console access or an external modem; not a data-networking Ethernet port, so no bandwidth grade set.

ports.name: USB-B
ports.note: Front-panel port; used for local configuration/firmware. USB speed not stated in the spec, so no grade set.

ports.name: USB-A (1)
ports.note: Front-panel host port; used for USB daisy-chain cascading (up to 32 PDUs) or an optional Wi-Fi dongle. USB speed not stated in the spec, so no grade set.

ports.name: USB-A (2)
ports.note: Second front-panel USB-A host port, same function as USB-A (1). USB speed not stated in the spec, so no grade set.
